## The model

<details markdown="1">
<summary>The same model, as math</summary>

The file states a plain `n.optimize()`, its multi-period class under the `multi_investment_periods` keyword, and its stochastic class, which `n.set_scenarios(...)` sets. Every quantity chosen once the future is known (second-stage) spans the futures dispatch is chosen in (`scenario`). Capacity is chosen once, before the future is known, and paid at its expected cost in each investment `period` its build year and lifetime span. Operation is the expectation over the scenarios' weights, with a share priced at the worst-outcome mean cost (CVaR) only where a risk preference is set. A plain run's data has one scenario, one period, unit weights, no outage and every `active` flag true, so the problem is the standard one. On a security-constrained run, PyPSA copies each branch flow limit once per `outage`, and the outage factors, `active` flags and scenario weights come from data prep.

| $`\mathit{Link\_modules}`$ | `Link_modules` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi`$ — how many modules a committed link's status counts: the chosen number where the build is extendable and modular, and the modules installed otherwise (`constraints.py:656-661`) |
| $`\mathit{Link\_opex}`$ | `Link_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Link\_output\_arrival}`$ | `Link_output_arrival` over $`\mathcal{O} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a link delivers to an output port at a snapshot. It is its flow delayed by the port's `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's efficiency at the snapshot the flow arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed flow wraps from the period's end. Where it is not, the flow still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port that does not delay (`delay` zero) delivers its flow unshifted, cyclic or not |
| $`\mathit{Link\_p\_carried\_over}`$ | `Link_p_carried_over` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the output a link carries over into a snapshot. At the first, it is the `p_init` it brought in, which is zero where it came in off. After that, it is the previous snapshot's |
| $`\mathrm{Link\_p\_nom\_committed}`$ | `Link_p_nom_committed` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi`$ — the build a committed link's ramp rows are taken against: one module where the build is modular, since its status counts modules, and the given build otherwise (`constraints.py:1131-1134`) |
| $`\mathit{Link\_p\_nom\_effective}`$ | `Link_p_nom_effective` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi`$ — the build a link's limits are taken against: the chosen one where it is extendable, the given one otherwise |
| $`\mathit{Link\_previous\_p}`$ | `Link_previous_p` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the output a link carries into a snapshot. It is nothing at the first snapshot it is active in past the first of the horizon: PyPSA fills an output it did not build with zero (`constraints.py:716`). It is the output carried over otherwise |
| $`\mathit{Link\_previous\_status}`$ | `Link_previous_status` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the commitment state a link carries into a snapshot. It is off at the first snapshot it is active in past the first of the horizon. PyPSA reads a status it did not build as off there (`constraints.py:391`). It is the state carried over otherwise |
| $`\mathit{Link\_ramp\_down\_allowance}`$ | `Link_ramp_down_allowance` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — how far a link may lower flow between two snapshots. It is its ramp limit of the build while it stays on, plus its shut-down ramp in the snapshot it turns off |
| $`\mathrm{Link\_ramp\_down\_rate}`$ | `Link_ramp_down_rate` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the ramp limit in a link's down row, PyPSA's `ramp_limit_down`. It is the full build where PyPSA has none, since a shut-down ramp alone builds the row |
| $`\mathit{Link\_ramp\_previous\_status}`$ | `Link_ramp_previous_status` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the status a committed link's ramp rows carry into a snapshot. At the first snapshot, a fixed modular link that came in running has every module on, since the state it brought in is on or off (`constraints.py:1152-1157`). The transition and down-time rows count it as one module (PyPSA/PyPSA\#2114). It is the state carried in otherwise |
| $`\mathit{Link\_ramp\_up\_allowance}`$ | `Link_ramp_up_allowance` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — how far a link may raise flow between two snapshots. It is its ramp limit of the build while it stays on, plus its start-up ramp in the snapshot it turns on |
| $`\mathrm{Link\_ramp\_up\_rate}`$ | `Link_ramp_up_rate` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the ramp limit in a link's up row, PyPSA's `ramp_limit_up`. It is the full build where PyPSA has none, since a start-up ramp alone builds the row |
| $`\mathrm{Link\_shut\_down\_rate}`$ | `Link_shut_down_rate` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi`$ — the shut-down ramp in a link's down row (PyPSA's `ramp_limit_shut_down`), or the full build where it has none |
| $`\mathrm{Link\_start\_up\_rate}`$ | `Link_start_up_rate` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi`$ — the start-up ramp in a link's up row (PyPSA's `ramp_limit_start_up`), or the full build where it has none |
| $`\mathit{Link\_status\_carried\_over}`$ | `Link_status_carried_over` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the state a link carries over into a snapshot: the state it brought into the horizon at the first, the previous snapshot's after that |
| $`\mathrm{Load\_demand}`$ | `Load_demand` over $`\mathcal{D} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a load draws from its bus's balance. It is its demand times its sign where it is active, and nothing where it is not. PyPSA drops an inactive load from the balance (`constraints.py:1591-1592`) |
| $`\mathrm{Load\_injection}`$ | `Load_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Process\_injection}`$ | `Process_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Process\_output\_arrival}`$ | `Process_output_arrival` over $`\mathcal{R} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a process transfers at a port at a snapshot. It is its internal power delayed by the port's `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's rate at the snapshot the transfer arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed transfer wraps from the period's end. Where it is not, the energy still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port that does not delay (`delay` zero) transfers at once, cyclic or not |
| $`\mathit{risk\_weighted\_opex}`$ | `risk_weighted_opex` (scalar) |
| $`\mathit{scenario\_opex}`$ | `scenario_opex` over $`\Xi`$ — what a future costs to run: every operating term, weighted by the snapshot's hours and its period, before the scenario's own weight. A start and a stop cost what they cost, unweighted, as PyPSA adds them (`optimize.py:448-468`) |
| $`\mathit{total\_cost}`$ | `total_cost` (scalar) — what the system costs. Capacity counts once per active period at its expected cost over the scenarios. Operation counts in expectation over the scenarios, and a share of it at the tail |

#### Notation

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $`t \ominus k`$ | `edge='wrap'` — $`t-k`$, cyclic |
| $`t \boxminus_{v} k`$ | `edge=v` — $`t-k`$, and $`v`$ past the edge |
| $`t \ominus^{\mathrm{relation}(t)} k`$ | `within=relation[...]` — $`t-k`$ inside the group of $`t`$ |
| $`\mathrm{pos}(t)`$ | `position()` — the position of $`t`$, counted from $`0`$; $`t`$ is the label |
| $`\mathrm{pos}_{\mathrm{relation}(t)}(t)`$ | `position(within=relation[...])` — the position of $`t`$ inside its group |

#### Conditions

**`Generator_marginal_cost_curve`**

```math
\mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}_{g} \iff \lvert \{ b \in \mathcal{B} \,:\, \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{curve}}_{b,g} \text{ is defined} \} \rvert > 0 \wedge \mathrm{act}_{g} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G}
```

**`Link_com_ext`**

```math
\mathrm{Link\_com\_ext}_{l,t} \iff \mathrm{com}^{f}_{l} \wedge \mathrm{ext}^{f}_{l} \wedge \neg \left( \mathrm{f}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{l} > 0 \right) \wedge \mathrm{on}^{f}_{l,t} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_committed`**

```math
\mathrm{Link\_committed}_{l,t} \iff \mathrm{com}^{f}_{l} \wedge \mathrm{on}^{f}_{l,t} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_ramps_from_previous`**

```math
\mathrm{Link\_ramps\_from\_previous}_{l,\xi,t} \iff \mathrm{pos}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)}(t) > 0 \vee \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \wedge \left( \mathrm{u}^{f,0}_{l,\xi} = 0 \vee \mathrm{f}^{0}_{l,\xi} \text{ is defined} \right) \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

#### Variable domains

**`Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise`**

```math
C^{\mathrm{curve}}_{g,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_p`**

```math
p_{g,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Link_n_mod`**

```math
N^{f}_{l} \ge 0, N^{f}_{l} \in \mathbb{Z} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L} \,:\, \mathrm{ext}^{f}_{l} \wedge \mathrm{f}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{l} > 0 \wedge \mathrm{act}^{f}_{l}
```

**`Link_p`**

```math
f_{l,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{f}_{l,t}
```

**`Link_p_nom_ext`**

```math
F_{l} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L} \,:\, \mathrm{ext}^{f}_{l} \wedge \mathrm{act}^{f}_{l}
```

**`Link_shut_down`**

```math
\mathit{dn}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \ge 0, \mathit{dn}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{Z} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Link\_committed}_{l,t}
```

**`Link_start_up`**

```math
\mathit{up}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \ge 0, \mathit{up}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{Z} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Link\_committed}_{l,t}
```

**`Link_status`**

```math
u^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \ge 0, u^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{Z} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Link\_committed}_{l,t}
```

**`Process_p`**

```math
z_{j,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{z}_{j,t}
```

#### Definitions

**`Bus_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Bus\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \mathit{Generator\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{Link\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathrm{Load\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{Process\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G} \,:\, \mathrm{Generator\_bus}(g) = n} \mathrm{sgn}_{g} \cdot p_{g,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_opex`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_opex}_{\xi} = \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G}} \mathit{Generator\_running\_cost}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G}} p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{(2)}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Generator_running_cost`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_running\_cost}_{g,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} C^{\mathrm{curve}}_{g,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}_{g} \\ p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}_{g,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_capex`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_capex} = \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi} \pi_{\xi} \cdot F_{l} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{\mathrm{cap},f}_{l,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{W}^{f}_{l}
```

**`Link_commitment_opex`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_commitment\_opex}_{\xi} = \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L}} u^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{f,\mathrm{on}}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L}} \mathit{up}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{f,\mathrm{up}}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L}} \mathit{dn}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{f,\mathrm{dn}}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Link_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = -\left( \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L} \,:\, \mathrm{Link\_bus0}(l) = n} f_{l,\xi,t} \right) + \sum_{o \in \mathcal{O} \,:\, \mathrm{Link\_output\_bus}(o) = n} \mathit{Link\_output\_arrival}_{o,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_modules`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_modules}_{l,\xi} = \begin{cases} N^{f}_{l} & \text{if } \mathrm{ext}^{f}_{l} \wedge \mathrm{f}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{l} > 0 \\ \mathrm{N}^{f,\mathrm{fix}}_{l,\xi} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Link_opex`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_opex}_{\xi} = \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L}} f_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L}} f_{l,\xi,t} \cdot f_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{f,(2)}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Link_output_arrival`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_output\_arrival}_{o,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} f_{\mathrm{Link\_output\_link}(o),\xi,t \ominus^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{f}} \cdot \eta_{o,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{cyc}^{f}_{o} \\ f_{\mathrm{Link\_output\_link}(o),\xi,t \boxminus_{0}^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{f}} \cdot \eta_{o,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, o \in \mathcal{O},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_p_carried_over`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_p\_carried\_over}_{l,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{f}^{0}_{l,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \\ f_{l,\xi,t - 1} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_p_nom_committed`**

```math
\mathrm{Link\_p\_nom\_committed}_{l,\xi} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{f}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{l} & \text{if } \mathrm{f}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{l} > 0 \\ \mathrm{f}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{l,\xi} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Link_p_nom_effective`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_p\_nom\_effective}_{l,\xi} = \begin{cases} F_{l} & \text{if } \mathrm{ext}^{f}_{l} \\ \mathrm{f}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{l,\xi} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Link_previous_p`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_previous\_p}_{l,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} 0 & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) > 0 \wedge \neg \mathrm{on}^{f}_{l,t - 1} \\ \mathit{Link\_p\_carried\_over}_{l,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_previous_status`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_previous\_status}_{l,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} 0 & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) > 0 \wedge \neg \mathrm{on}^{f}_{l,t - 1} \\ \mathit{Link\_status\_carried\_over}_{l,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_ramp_down_allowance`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_ramp\_down\_allowance}_{l,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{Link\_ramp\_down\_rate}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{Link\_p\_nom\_committed}_{l,\xi} \cdot u^{f}_{l,\xi,t} + \mathrm{Link\_shut\_down\_rate}_{l,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{Link\_p\_nom\_committed}_{l,\xi} \cdot \left( \mathit{Link\_ramp\_previous\_status}_{l,\xi,t} - u^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \right) & \text{if } \mathrm{com}^{f}_{l} \\ \mathrm{Link\_ramp\_down\_rate}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathit{Link\_p\_nom\_effective}_{l,\xi} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_ramp_down_rate`**

```math
\mathrm{Link\_ramp\_down\_rate}_{l,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{rd}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{rd}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \text{ is defined} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_ramp_previous_status`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_ramp\_previous\_status}_{l,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{u}^{f,0}_{l,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{N}^{f,\mathrm{fix}}_{l,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \wedge \neg \mathrm{ext}^{f}_{l} \wedge \mathrm{f}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{l} > 0 \\ \mathit{Link\_previous\_status}_{l,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_ramp_up_allowance`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_ramp\_up\_allowance}_{l,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{Link\_ramp\_up\_rate}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{Link\_p\_nom\_committed}_{l,\xi} \cdot \mathit{Link\_ramp\_previous\_status}_{l,\xi,t} + \mathrm{Link\_start\_up\_rate}_{l,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{Link\_p\_nom\_committed}_{l,\xi} \cdot \left( u^{f}_{l,\xi,t} - \mathit{Link\_ramp\_previous\_status}_{l,\xi,t} \right) & \text{if } \mathrm{com}^{f}_{l} \\ \mathrm{Link\_ramp\_up\_rate}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathit{Link\_p\_nom\_effective}_{l,\xi} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_ramp_up_rate`**

```math
\mathrm{Link\_ramp\_up\_rate}_{l,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{ru}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{ru}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \text{ is defined} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_shut_down_rate`**

```math
\mathrm{Link\_shut\_down\_rate}_{l,\xi} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{rd}^{f,\mathrm{dn}}_{l,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{rd}^{f,\mathrm{dn}}_{l,\xi} \text{ is defined} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Link_start_up_rate`**

```math
\mathrm{Link\_start\_up\_rate}_{l,\xi} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{ru}^{f,\mathrm{up}}_{l,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{ru}^{f,\mathrm{up}}_{l,\xi} \text{ is defined} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Link_status_carried_over`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_status\_carried\_over}_{l,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{u}^{f,0}_{l,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \\ u^{f}_{l,\xi,t - 1} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Load_demand`**

```math
\mathrm{Load\_demand}_{d,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{sgn}^{\mathrm{load}}_{d} \cdot \mathrm{load}_{d,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{on}^{\mathrm{load}}_{d} \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, d \in \mathcal{D},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Load_injection`**

```math
\mathrm{Load\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \sum_{d \in \mathcal{D} \,:\, \mathrm{Load\_bus}(d) = n} \mathrm{Load\_demand}_{d,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R} \,:\, \mathrm{Process\_output\_bus}(r) = n} \mathit{Process\_output\_arrival}_{r,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_output_arrival`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_output\_arrival}_{r,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} z_{\mathrm{Process\_output\_process}(r),\xi,t \ominus^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{z}} \cdot \alpha_{r,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{cyc}^{z}_{r} \\ z_{\mathrm{Process\_output\_process}(r),\xi,t \boxminus_{0}^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{z}} \cdot \alpha_{r,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, r \in \mathcal{R},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`risk_weighted_opex`**

```math
\mathit{risk\_weighted\_opex} = \sum_{\xi \in \Xi} \pi_{\xi} \cdot \mathit{scenario\_opex}_{\xi}
```

**`scenario_opex`**

```math
\mathit{scenario\_opex}_{\xi} = \mathit{Generator\_opex}_{\xi} + \mathit{Link\_opex}_{\xi} + \mathit{Link\_commitment\_opex}_{\xi} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`total_cost`**

```math
\mathit{total\_cost} = \mathit{Link\_capex} + \mathit{risk\_weighted\_opex}
```

#### Objective

```math
\min \mathit{total\_cost}
```

#### Subject to

**`Bus_nodal_balance`**

```math
\mathit{Bus\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = 0 \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Bus\_attached}_{n,t}
```

**`Generator_fix_p_lower`**

```math
p_{g,\xi,t} \ge \underline{\mathrm{p}}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \neg \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \neg \mathrm{com}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_fix_p_upper`**

```math
p_{g,\xi,t} \le \overline{\mathrm{p}}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \neg \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \neg \mathrm{com}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Link_com_down_time`**

```math
\sum_{t' \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, 0 \le t - t' < \mathrm{DT}^{f}} \mathit{dn}^{f}_{l,\xi,t'} + \mathrm{rest}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \le \mathit{Link\_modules}_{l,\xi} - u^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Link\_committed}_{l,t} \wedge \mathrm{DT}^{f}_{l,\xi} > 0
```

**`Link_com_ext_p_lower`**

```math

      future is known (second-stage) spans the futures dispatch is chosen in (`scenario`). Capacity is chosen
      once, before the future is known, and paid at its expected cost in each investment `period` its build
      year and lifetime span. Operation is the expectation over the scenarios' weights, with a share priced
      at the worst-outcome mean cost (CVaR) only where a risk preference is set. A plain run's data has one
      scenario, one period, unit weights, no outage and every `active` flag true, so the problem is the standard
      one. On a security-constrained run, PyPSA copies each branch flow limit once per `outage`, and the outage
      factors, `active` flags and scenario weights come from data prep.

      generator: {description: 'generating units, each on one bus'}
      link: {description: 'controllable connections, each from one bus to the buses it delivers to'}

      process_output: {description: 'a process''s ports, one label per port a process declares. The labels

          is PyPSA's start `up_time_before` snapshots before the first, counted while `min_up_time` has not
          passed since (`constraints.py:302-323`, `:677-678`), data prep. Under a rolling horizon with linearised
          unit commitment, it is the fraction of the start the previous window solved
      Load_active:
        dims: [load]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a load is active in the network, PyPSA's `active`. A load has no build year and
          no lifetime, so the flag is the same in every snapshot. PyPSA refuses one that differs by scenario
          (`constants.py:54`)
      Load_p_set:
        dims: [load, scenario, snapshot]
        description: demand
      Load_sign:
        dims: [load]
        description: the sign a load's demand enters its bus's balance with. It is PyPSA's `sign`, `-1` unless
          given, `1` for a load that feeds its bus. PyPSA refuses one that differs by scenario (`constants.py:46`)
      Process_active:
        dims: [process, snapshot]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a process is active in a snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `active`, data prep
      Process_output_cyclic_delay:
        dims: [process_output]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a delayed port's transfer wraps from the end of its investment period (PyPSA's
          `cyclic_delay0`, `cyclic_delay1`, …). Where it does not, the energy still in transit at each period's
          first snapshots is lost. The flag is the same in every scenario, as the delay is
      Process_output_delay:
        dims: [process_output]
        dtype: int
        description: snapshots a port's transfer lags its process's internal power (PyPSA's `delay0`, `delay1`,
          … read long). In data prep you divide it by the `snapshot_weightings.generators` value and round
          it up. It is zero for a port that transfers at once. A port has the same delay in every scenario,
          as a link's port has
      Process_rate:
        dims: [process_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the energy a port draws or delivers per unit of internal power (PyPSA's `rate0`, `rate1`,
          … read long). It is negative where the port withdraws and positive where it injects. A link is a
          process whose `bus0` rate is minus one and whose output rates are its efficiencies. The rate at
          the snapshot the transfer arrives applies, so a delayed port transfers at its arrival snapshot's
          rate (`constraints.py:1575`)
      period_weight_objective:
        dims: [period]
        description: PyPSA's `investment_period_weightings.objective` — what a period's cost weighs. PyPSA
          reads it only under `multi_investment_periods`. Otherwise you feed one in data prep, whatever the
          column contains (`optimize.py:231-233`, `:293-297`)
      scenario_weight:
        dims: [scenario]
        description: PyPSA's `scenario_weightings.weight` — the probability of a future
      snapshot_weightings_objective:
        dims: [snapshot]
        description: PyPSA's `snapshot_weightings.objective` — hours a snapshot weighs in the cost
    variables:
      Generator_p:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_active
        description: '`Generator-p` — output of a generator in a snapshot'
      Link_n_mod:
        dims: [link]
        where: Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_p_nom_mod > 0 AND Link_active_asset
        bounds: {lower: 0.0}
        domain: integer
        description: '`Link-n_mod` — how many modules of an extendable modular build. A unit that is not active
          has none'
      Link_p:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_active
        description: '`Link-p` — PyPSA''s `p0`, the flow measured at the `Link_bus0` end. A positive value
          withdraws there and injects at every bus the link''s output ports deliver to'
      Link_p_nom_ext:
        dims: [link]
        where: Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_active_asset
        description: '`Link-p_nom` — nominal power where it is a decision, for a link that is active. A fixed
          build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name'
      Link_shut_down:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_committed
        bounds: {lower: 0.0}
        domain: integer
        description: '`Link-shut_down` — how much of a committable link turns off this snapshot, capped as
          the status is'
      Link_start_up:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_committed
        bounds: {lower: 0.0}
        domain: integer
        description: '`Link-start_up` — how much of a committable link turns on this snapshot, capped as the
          status is'
      Link_status:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_committed
        bounds: {lower: 0.0}
        domain: integer
        description: '`Link-status` — how much of a committable link is on. It is an integer the rows below
          cap at one, or at the module count where the build is modular'
      Process_p:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_active
        description: '`Process-p` — PyPSA''s internal power `p`. A positive value drives every port at its
          own rate, withdrawing where the rate is negative and injecting where it is positive'
      Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_marginal_cost_curve AND Generator_active
        description: '`Generator-marginal_cost_piecewise` — the running cost of a generator that pays along
          a curve, held above the curve'
    constraints:
      Bus_nodal_balance:
        dims: [bus, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Bus_attached
        expression: Bus_injection == 0
        description: '`Bus-nodal_balance` — what is generated at a bus meets the load there, less half of
          every incident line''s and transformer''s loss. What is generated includes storage dispatch and
          stores. It is net of what the links take away, plus what arrives over them after losses and any
          delay at every port they deliver to. Each process port draws or delivers at its own rate, and each
          passive branch carries its flow. PyPSA dissipates a branch''s loss half at either end. Each generator,
          storage unit, store and load term enters with its component''s `sign` (`constraints.py:1480-1481`,
          `:1592`), and an inactive load not at all. A bus nothing is attached to has no row. PyPSA refuses
          one that carries load. The file states no assumption for it.'
      Generator_fix_p_lower:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Generator_p_nom_extendable AND not Generator_committable AND Generator_active
        expression: Generator_p >= Generator_p_min_pu * Generator_p_nom
        description: '`Generator-fix-p-lower` — a fixed generator outputs at least its minimum'
      Generator_fix_p_upper:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Generator_p_nom_extendable AND not Generator_committable AND Generator_active
        expression: Generator_p <= Generator_p_max_pu * Generator_p_nom
        description: '`Generator-fix-p-upper` — a fixed generator outputs at most what is available'
      Link_com_down_time:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_committed AND Link_min_down_time > 0
        expression: sum_back(Link_shut_down, along=snapshot, window=Link_min_down_time) + Link_down_time_brought_in
          <= Link_modules - Link_status
        description: '`Link-com-down-time` — a link stopped within its own minimum down time is still off,
          and so are the modules of a modular link that stopped. The down time it brought into the horizon
          counts as one stop before the first snapshot, also where the link is modular and all its modules
          stopped (`constraints.py:656-683`, PyPSA/PyPSA#2114)'
      Link_com_ext_p_lower:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_com_ext
        expression: Link_p >= ((Link_p_min_pu * Link_p_nom_ext) + (Link_big_m * Link_status)) - Link_big_m
        description: '`Link-com-ext-p-lower` — a committed extendable link flows at least its minimum of the
          chosen build. Off, the big M releases the row'
      Link_com_ext_p_lower_nonneg:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_com_ext AND Link_p_min_pu_nonneg
        expression: Link_p >= 0
        description: '`Link-com-ext-p-lower-nonneg` — where no minimum-per-unit is negative, flow is also
          plainly non-negative, a row the big-M lower cannot assert while the link is off'
      Link_com_ext_p_upper_big_m:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_com_ext
        expression: Link_p <= Link_big_m * Link_status
        description: '`Link-com-ext-p-upper-bigM` — off, a link flows nothing. On, the big M is no bound'
      Link_com_ext_p_upper_cap:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_com_ext
        expression: Link_p <= Link_p_max_pu * Link_p_nom_ext
        description: '`Link-com-ext-p-upper-cap` — a committed extendable link flows at most what is available
          of the chosen build, whatever its status'
      Link_com_mod_p_lower:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_committed AND Link_p_nom_mod > 0
        expression: Link_p >= (Link_p_min_pu * Link_p_nom_mod) * Link_status
        description: '`Link-com-mod-p-lower` — a committed modular link flows at least its minimum of one
          module, whether the build is fixed or a decision'
      Link_com_mod_p_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_committed AND Link_p_nom_mod > 0
        expression: Link_p <= (Link_p_max_pu * Link_p_nom_mod) * Link_status
        description: '`Link-com-mod-p-upper` — a committed modular link flows at most one module''s share,
          whether the build is fixed or a decision'
      Link_com_p_lower:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_committed AND NOT Link_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Link_p_nom_mod > 0)
        expression: Link_p >= (Link_p_min_pu * Link_p_nom) * Link_status
        description: '`Link-com-p-lower` — a committed link flows at least its minimum. Off, it flows at least
          nothing'
      Link_com_p_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_committed AND NOT Link_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Link_p_nom_mod > 0)
        expression: Link_p <= (Link_p_max_pu * Link_p_nom) * Link_status
        description: '`Link-com-p-upper` — a committed link flows at most what is available. Off, it flows
          at most nothing'
      Link_com_transition_shut_down:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_committed
        expression: Link_shut_down >= Link_previous_status - Link_status
        description: '`Link-com-transition-shut-down` — turning off is a stop, counted against the state the
          link carried into the snapshot'
      Link_com_transition_start_up:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_committed
        expression: Link_start_up >= Link_status - Link_previous_status
        description: '`Link-com-transition-start-up` — turning on is a start, counted against the state the
          link carried into the snapshot'
      Link_com_up_time:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_committed AND Link_min_up_time > 0
        expression: sum_back(Link_start_up, along=snapshot, window=Link_min_up_time) + Link_up_time_brought_in
          <= Link_status
        description: '`Link-com-up-time` — a link started within its own minimum up time is still on. The
          up time it brought into the horizon counts as a start before the first snapshot'
      Link_ext_p_nom_lower:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        where: Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_active_asset
        expression: Link_p_nom_ext >= Link_p_nom_min
        description: '`Link-ext-p_nom-lower` — the chosen build is at least its floor in every scenario'
      Link_ext_p_nom_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        where: Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_active_asset AND Link_p_nom_max
        expression: Link_p_nom_ext <= Link_p_nom_max
        description: '`Link-ext-p_nom-upper` — the chosen build is at most its cap in every scenario. A cap
          of infinity is no row'
      Link_fix_p_lower:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Link_p_nom_extendable AND not Link_committable AND Link_active
        expression: Link_p >= Link_p_min_pu * Link_p_nom
        description: '`Link-fix-p-lower` — a fixed link carries at least its minimum, negative for the other
          way'
      Link_fix_p_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Link_p_nom_extendable AND not Link_committable AND Link_active
        expression: Link_p <= Link_p_max_pu * Link_p_nom
        description: '`Link-fix-p-upper` — a fixed link carries at most its nominal power'
      Link_p_nom_modularity:
        dims: [link]
        where: Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_p_nom_mod > 0 AND Link_active_asset
        expression: Link_p_nom_ext == Link_p_nom_mod * Link_n_mod
        description: '`Link-p_nom_modularity` — the chosen build is a whole number of modules'
      Link_p_ramp_limit_down:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: (Link_ramp_limit_down OR Link_ramp_limit_shut_down) AND NOT (Link_committable AND Link_p_nom_extendable
          AND NOT (Link_p_nom_mod > 0)) AND Link_ramps_from_previous AND Link_active
        expression: Link_previous_p - Link_p <= Link_ramp_down_allowance
        description: '`Link-p-ramp_limit_down` — a link lowers flow no faster than its ramp limit of the build.
          A committed one lowers it no further than its shut-down ramp in the snapshot it turns off. A link
          that came into the horizon running has a row at the first snapshot only where its `p_init` gives
          the flow it brought in. No link has one at the start of a later investment period, nor does any
          link a big M releases instead'
      Link_p_ramp_limit_down_run_big_m:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_com_ext AND (Link_ramp_limit_down OR Link_ramp_limit_shut_down) AND Link_ramps_from_previous
        expression: Link_p - Link_previous_p >= -Link_ramp_down_rate * Link_p_nom_ext - Link_big_m + Link_big_m
          * Link_status
        description: '`Link-p-ramp_limit_down-run-bigM` — a committed extendable link lowers flow no faster
          than its limit of the chosen build. The big M releases the row in the snapshot it turns off'
      Link_p_ramp_limit_down_shut_big_m:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_com_ext AND (Link_ramp_limit_down OR Link_ramp_limit_shut_down) AND Link_ramps_from_previous
        expression: Link_previous_p - Link_p <= Link_shut_down_rate * Link_p_nom_ext + Link_big_m - Link_big_m
          * Link_shut_down
        description: '`Link-p-ramp_limit_down-shut-bigM` — in the snapshot it turns off, a committed extendable
          link ramps no further than its shut-down ramp of the chosen build. The big M releases the row everywhere
          else'
      Link_p_ramp_limit_up:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: (Link_ramp_limit_up OR Link_ramp_limit_start_up) AND NOT (Link_committable AND Link_p_nom_extendable
          AND NOT (Link_p_nom_mod > 0)) AND Link_ramps_from_previous AND Link_active
        expression: Link_p - Link_previous_p <= Link_ramp_up_allowance
        description: '`Link-p-ramp_limit_up` — a link raises flow no faster than its ramp limit of the build.
          A committed one raises it no further than its start-up ramp in the snapshot it turns on. A link
          that came into the horizon running has a row at the first snapshot only where its `p_init` gives
          the flow it brought in. No link has one at the start of a later investment period, nor does any
          link a big M releases instead'
      Link_p_ramp_limit_up_run_big_m:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_com_ext AND (Link_ramp_limit_up OR Link_ramp_limit_start_up) AND Link_ramps_from_previous
        expression: Link_p - Link_previous_p <= Link_ramp_up_rate * Link_p_nom_ext + Link_big_m - Link_big_m
          * Link_previous_status
        description: '`Link-p-ramp_limit_up-run-bigM` — a committed extendable link raises flow no faster
          than its limit of the chosen build. The big M releases the row in the snapshot it turns on'
      Link_p_ramp_limit_up_start_big_m:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_com_ext AND (Link_ramp_limit_up OR Link_ramp_limit_start_up) AND Link_ramps_from_previous
        expression: Link_p - Link_previous_p <= Link_start_up_rate * Link_p_nom_ext + Link_big_m - Link_big_m
          * Link_start_up
        description: '`Link-p-ramp_limit_up-start-bigM` — in the snapshot it turns on, a committed extendable
          link ramps no further than its start-up ramp of the chosen build. The big M releases the row everywhere
          else'
      Link_shut_down_p_fixed_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_committed AND NOT (Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_p_nom_mod > 0)
        expression: Link_shut_down <= Link_modules_installed
        description: '`Link-shut_down-p-fixed-upper` — a stop is at most the modules in place, an explicit
          row as PyPSA writes it. The bound is one where the build is not modular, and the fixed build''s
          whole count of modules where it is'
      Link_shut_down_p_nom_variable_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_committed AND Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_p_nom_mod > 0
        expression: Link_shut_down <= Link_n_mod
        description: '`Link-shut_down-p_nom-variable-upper` — a modular link stops only where a module is
          built'
      Link_start_up_p_fixed_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_committed AND NOT (Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_p_nom_mod > 0)
        expression: Link_start_up <= Link_modules_installed
        description: '`Link-start_up-p-fixed-upper` — a start is at most the modules in place, an explicit
          row as PyPSA writes it. The bound is one where the build is not modular, and the fixed build''s
          whole count of modules where it is'
      Link_start_up_p_nom_variable_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_committed AND Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_p_nom_mod > 0
        expression: Link_start_up <= Link_n_mod
        description: '`Link-start_up-p_nom-variable-upper` — a modular link starts only where a module is
          built'
      Link_status_p_fixed_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_committed AND NOT (Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_p_nom_mod > 0)
        expression: Link_status <= Link_modules_installed
        description: '`Link-status-p-fixed-upper` — a status is at most the modules in place, an explicit
          row as PyPSA writes it. The bound is one where the build is not modular, and the fixed build''s
          whole count of modules where it is'
      Link_status_p_nom_variable_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_committed AND Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_p_nom_mod > 0
        expression: Link_status <= Link_n_mod
        description: '`Link-status-p_nom-variable-upper` — a modular link is on only where a module is built'
    expressions:
      Bus_injection:
        dims: [bus, scenario, snapshot]
        expression: ((Generator_injection + Link_injection) + Load_injection) + Process_injection
        description: what every component puts into a bus, less what it takes out of it. PyPSA writes each
          term into the balance, and a load on its right-hand side
      Generator_injection: {expression: 'sum(Generator_sign * Generator_p, over=generator, by=Generator_bus[bus])'}
      Generator_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum((Generator_running_cost * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=generator), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Generator_p * Generator_p)
          * Generator_marginal_cost_quadratic) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=generator), over=snapshot)'}
      Generator_running_cost:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'what a generator''s output costs in a snapshot: the value read off its piecewise curve
          where it has one, and its linear `marginal_cost` otherwise. A curve replaces the linear cost, as
          PyPSA drops the unit from that term (`optimize.py:333-348`)'
        cases:
          curve: {when: Generator_marginal_cost_curve, expression: Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise}
        otherwise: Generator_p * Generator_marginal_cost
      Link_capex: {expression: sum(scenario_weight * Link_p_nom_ext * Link_capital_cost * Link_capital_weight)}
      Link_commitment_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum(((Link_status * Link_stand_by_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective)
          * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=link), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((Link_start_up
          * Link_start_up_cost) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=link), over=snapshot)
          + sum(sum((Link_shut_down * Link_shut_down_cost) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]),
          over=link), over=snapshot)'}
      Link_injection: {expression: '-sum(Link_p, over=link, by=Link_bus0[bus]) + sum(Link_output_arrival,
          over=link_output, by=Link_output_bus[bus])'}
      Link_modules:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        description: 'how many modules a committed link''s status counts: the chosen number where the build
          is extendable and modular, and the modules installed otherwise (`constraints.py:656-661`)'
        cases:
          chosen: {when: Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_p_nom_mod > 0, expression: Link_n_mod}
        otherwise: Link_modules_installed
      Link_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum(((Link_p * Link_marginal_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=link), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Link_p * Link_p) * Link_marginal_cost_quadratic)
          * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=link),
          over=snapshot)'}
      Link_output_arrival:
        dims: [link_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a link delivers to an output port at a snapshot. It is its flow delayed by the port's
          `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's efficiency at the snapshot
          the flow arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed flow wraps from the period's end.
          Where it is not, the flow still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port that
          does not delay (`delay` zero) delivers its flow unshifted, cyclic or not
        cases:
          wrapping: {when: Link_output_cyclic_delay, expression: 'shift(at(Link_p, by=Link_output_link[link]),
              along=snapshot, offset=Link_output_delay, edge=''wrap'', within=snapshot_period[period]) * Link_efficiency'}
        otherwise: shift(at(Link_p, by=Link_output_link[link]), along=snapshot, offset=Link_output_delay,
          edge=0, within=snapshot_period[period]) * Link_efficiency
      Link_p_carried_over:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the output a link carries over into a snapshot. At the first, it is the `p_init` it brought
          in, which is zero where it came in off. After that, it is the previous snapshot's
        cases:
          opening: {when: position(snapshot) == 0, expression: Link_p_init}
        otherwise: shift(Link_p, along=snapshot, offset=1)
      Link_p_nom_committed:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        description: 'the build a committed link''s ramp rows are taken against: one module where the build
          is modular, since its status counts modules, and the given build otherwise (`constraints.py:1131-1134`)'
        cases:
          modular_build: {when: Link_p_nom_mod > 0, expression: Link_p_nom_mod}
        otherwise: Link_p_nom
      Link_p_nom_effective:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        description: 'the build a link''s limits are taken against: the chosen one where it is extendable,
          the given one otherwise'
        cases:
          extendable: {when: Link_p_nom_extendable, expression: Link_p_nom_ext}
        otherwise: Link_p_nom
      Link_previous_p:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'the output a link carries into a snapshot. It is nothing at the first snapshot it is
          active in past the first of the horizon: PyPSA fills an output it did not build with zero (`constraints.py:716`).
          It is the output carried over otherwise'
        cases:
          opening_late: {when: 'position(snapshot) > 0 AND NOT shift(Link_active, along=snapshot, offset=1)',
            expression: '0'}
        otherwise: Link_p_carried_over
      Link_previous_status:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the commitment state a link carries into a snapshot. It is off at the first snapshot
          it is active in past the first of the horizon. PyPSA reads a status it did not build as off there
          (`constraints.py:391`). It is the state carried over otherwise
        cases:
          opening_late: {when: 'position(snapshot) > 0 AND NOT shift(Link_active, along=snapshot, offset=1)',
            expression: '0'}
        otherwise: Link_status_carried_over
      Link_ramp_down_allowance:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: how far a link may lower flow between two snapshots. It is its ramp limit of the build
          while it stays on, plus its shut-down ramp in the snapshot it turns off
        cases:
          committed: {when: Link_committable, expression: Link_ramp_down_rate * Link_p_nom_committed * Link_status
              + Link_shut_down_rate * Link_p_nom_committed * (Link_ramp_previous_status - Link_status)}
        otherwise: Link_ramp_down_rate * Link_p_nom_effective
      Link_ramp_down_rate:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the ramp limit in a link's down row, PyPSA's `ramp_limit_down`. It is the full build
          where PyPSA has none, since a shut-down ramp alone builds the row
        cases:
          given: {when: Link_ramp_limit_down, expression: Link_ramp_limit_down}
        otherwise: '1'
      Link_ramp_previous_status:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the status a committed link's ramp rows carry into a snapshot. At the first snapshot,
          a fixed modular link that came in running has every module on, since the state it brought in is
          on or off (`constraints.py:1152-1157`). The transition and down-time rows count it as one module
          (PyPSA/PyPSA#2114). It is the state carried in otherwise
        cases:
          opening_modules: {when: position(snapshot) == 0 AND NOT Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_p_nom_mod
              > 0, expression: Link_status_initial * Link_modules_installed}
        otherwise: Link_previous_status
      Link_ramp_up_allowance:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: how far a link may raise flow between two snapshots. It is its ramp limit of the build
          while it stays on, plus its start-up ramp in the snapshot it turns on
        cases:
          committed: {when: Link_committable, expression: Link_ramp_up_rate * Link_p_nom_committed * Link_ramp_previous_status
              + Link_start_up_rate * Link_p_nom_committed * (Link_status - Link_ramp_previous_status)}
        otherwise: Link_ramp_up_rate * Link_p_nom_effective
      Link_ramp_up_rate:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the ramp limit in a link's up row, PyPSA's `ramp_limit_up`. It is the full build where
          PyPSA has none, since a start-up ramp alone builds the row
        cases:
          given: {when: Link_ramp_limit_up, expression: Link_ramp_limit_up}
        otherwise: '1'
      Link_shut_down_rate:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        description: the shut-down ramp in a link's down row (PyPSA's `ramp_limit_shut_down`), or the full
          build where it has none
        cases:
          given: {when: Link_ramp_limit_shut_down, expression: Link_ramp_limit_shut_down}
        otherwise: '1'
      Link_start_up_rate:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        description: the start-up ramp in a link's up row (PyPSA's `ramp_limit_start_up`), or the full build
          where it has none
        cases:
          given: {when: Link_ramp_limit_start_up, expression: Link_ramp_limit_start_up}
        otherwise: '1'
      Link_status_carried_over:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'the state a link carries over into a snapshot: the state it brought into the horizon
          at the first, the previous snapshot''s after that'
        cases:
          opening: {when: position(snapshot) == 0, expression: Link_status_initial}
        otherwise: shift(Link_status, along=snapshot, offset=1)
      Load_demand:
        dims: [load, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a load draws from its bus's balance. It is its demand times its sign where it is
          active, and nothing where it is not. PyPSA drops an inactive load from the balance (`constraints.py:1591-1592`)
        cases:
          active: {when: Load_active, expression: Load_sign * Load_p_set}
        otherwise: '0'
      Load_injection: {expression: 'sum(Load_demand, over=load, by=Load_bus[bus])'}
      Process_injection: {expression: 'sum(Process_output_arrival, over=process_output, by=Process_output_bus[bus])'}
      Process_output_arrival:
        dims: [process_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a process transfers at a port at a snapshot. It is its internal power delayed by
          the port's `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's rate at the snapshot
          the transfer arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed transfer wraps from the period's
          end. Where it is not, the energy still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port
          that does not delay (`delay` zero) transfers at once, cyclic or not
        cases:
          wrapping: {when: Process_output_cyclic_delay, expression: 'shift(at(Process_p, by=Process_output_process[process]),
              along=snapshot, offset=Process_output_delay, edge=''wrap'', within=snapshot_period[period])
              * Process_rate'}
        otherwise: shift(at(Process_p, by=Process_output_process[process]), along=snapshot, offset=Process_output_delay,
          edge=0, within=snapshot_period[period]) * Process_rate
      risk_weighted_opex: {expression: 'sum(scenario_weight * scenario_opex, over=scenario)'}
      scenario_opex:
        dims: [scenario]
        expression: (Generator_opex + Link_opex) + Link_commitment_opex
        description: 'what a future costs to run: every operating term, weighted by the snapshot''s hours
          and its period, before the scenario''s own weight. A start and a stop cost what they cost, unweighted,
          as PyPSA adds them (`optimize.py:448-468`)'
      total_cost:
        dims: []
        expression: Link_capex + risk_weighted_opex
        description: what the system costs. Capacity counts once per active period at its expected cost over
          the scenarios. Operation counts in expectation over the scenarios, and a share of it at the tail
    conditions:
      Generator_marginal_cost_curve: {condition: 'count(Generator_marginal_cost_curve_p, over=breakpoint)
          > 0 AND Generator_active_asset', description: 'a generator that pays along a piecewise `marginal_cost`
          curve: one of PyPSA''s `active_assets` with curve data (`optimize.py:307`, `piecewise.py:230-257`)'}
      Link_com_ext: {condition: Link_committable AND Link_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Link_p_nom_mod > 0) AND
          Link_active, description: 'a committable link with an extendable, non-modular build that is active
          in the snapshot''s period. These are PyPSA''s `com-ext` rows, whose status is relaxed against the
          chosen build'}
      Link_committed: {condition: Link_committable AND Link_active, description: 'a committable link that
          is active in the snapshot''s period: every unit-commitment row''s set'}
      Link_ramps_from_previous: {condition: 'position(snapshot, within=snapshot_period[period]) > 0 OR (position(snapshot)
          == 0 AND (Link_status_initial == 0 OR Link_p_init))', description: 'a snapshot whose ramp uses a
          previous output. It is any snapshot but its period''s first, and the horizon''s first where the
          link comes in off or carries an initial output'}
    objective: {sense: minimize, expression: total_cost}
    ```

    The prep — every table the spec declares, from the network — and the solve:

    ```python
    from differential.pypsa.prep import relation, static, varying, weighting


    n = build()  # the network from the PyPSA tab

    sources = {
        'bus': pl.Series('bus', list(names(n.buses.index).astype(str)), dtype=pl.String),
            **{
                dim: pl.Series(dim, list(names(n.static(component).index).astype(str)), dtype=pl.String)
                for component, dim in DIM.items()
            },
            **scenarios(n),
            **periods(n, multi),
            **carriers(n, multi),
        'snapshot': pl.Series('snapshot', list(timesteps(n)), dtype=pl.Datetime('us')),
        'Generator_bus': relation(n, 'Generator', 'bus'),
        'Link_bus0': relation(n, 'Link', 'bus0'),
        'Load_bus': relation(n, 'Load', 'bus'),
        'Bus_attached': attached(n),
        'Generator_sign': per_component('Generator', first_scenario(n.generators['sign'])),
        'Load_active': per_component('Load', first_scenario(loads['active']), bool),
        'Load_p_set': varying(n, 'Load', 'p_set'),
        'Load_sign': per_component('Load', first_scenario(loads['sign'])),
        'snapshot_weightings_objective': weighting(n, 'objective'),
    }

    with sps.solve('differential/pypsa/rungs/rung_25_committable_link.yaml', sources) as result:
        result.objective  # 13982.0
    ```

=== "PyPSA"

    The network, `rung_25_committable_link.py` in the corpus — the spine plus what this rung adds:

    ```python
    # SPDX-FileCopyrightText: mathspec Contributors
    #
    # SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

    """Rung 25: committable links — a link held on by the up time it brought in, one held off by its down time, one kept on by its own up time, and committable builds that are extendable, modular or both."""

    from __future__ import annotations

    import spine


    def build():
        """The spine plus an east bus that only committable links serve."""
        n = spine.build()
        n.add('Bus', 'east')
        n.add(
            'Link',
            'hvdc',
            bus0='north',
            bus1='east',
            committable=True,
            p_nom=60,
            p_min_pu=0.3,
            marginal_cost=8,
            min_up_time=3,
            min_down_time=2,
            up_time_before=1,
            ramp_limit_up=0.5,
            ramp_limit_down=0.5,
            ramp_limit_start_up=0.6,
            ramp_limit_shut_down=0.6,
            start_up_cost=100,
            shut_down_cost=50,
            stand_by_cost=5,
        )
        n.add(
            'Link',
            'cold_tie',
            bus0='north',
            bus1='east',
            committable=True,
            p_nom=40,
            p_min_pu=0.2,
            min_up_time=2,
            min_down_time=3,
            up_time_before=0,
            down_time_before=1,
            start_up_cost=20,
        )
        n.add(
            'Link',
            'ext_tie',
            bus0='north',
            bus1='east',
            committable=True,
            p_nom_extendable=True,
            p_nom_max=30,
            capital_cost=5,
            p_min_pu=0.2,
            marginal_cost=2,
            up_time_before=0,
            ramp_limit_up=0.5,
            ramp_limit_down=0.5,
        )
        n.add(
            'Link',
            'mod_tie',
            bus0='south',
            bus1='east',
            committable=True,
            p_nom_extendable=True,
            p_nom_mod=10,
            p_nom_max=40,
            capital_cost=3,
            p_min_pu=0.5,
        )
        n.add(
            'Link',
            'mod_fix',
            bus0='north',
            bus1='east',
            committable=True,
            p_nom=20,
            p_nom_mod=10,
            p_min_pu=0.5,
            marginal_cost=1,
        )
        n.add('Load', 'east_load', bus='east', p_set=[20, 70, 60, 5])
        return n
    ```

    ```python
    n = build()
    n.optimize(solver_name='highs')
    n.objective  # 13982.0
    ```
